**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (Note: #1368 is a duplicate PR from the same claim race; the earliest-claim rule keeps this one.)

**What looks good**
- Test-only change in `crates/app/tests/mcp_live.rs` (10+/2-); the server is untouched.
- The post-deadline read now accepts EOF, or ConnectionReset/ConnectionAborted/BrokenPipe, as the drop. When the idle note does arrive it is still asserted. Any other error (the 5 s read timeout, i.e. client still connected past the schedule) panics with "never dropped", and the `>= 350 ms` / `< 1500 ms` window asserts still apply, so a client that stays connected still fails. No retries or longer sleeps.
- The cause (RST discarding the idle note when the trickler's bytes are unread) is explained in the code comment and matches the failure.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, clean merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_live` | 10 passed, 0 failed |
| same binary x20 with every core saturated by busy loops (other app test binaries also running on the host) | 20/20 ok |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Run on macOS (the reporting host).

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Process: body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #1366`; commit subject is conventional; no process files touched; no snapshot/golden changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
